summary: PMConcept7 tweak wave 8 (2026-08-15): four re-diagnosed behaviors sealed with dated dispositions after the user rejected all four wave-7 items, each re-diagnosis having found that wave 7 missed the real mechanism. (1) Kebab geometry canon - the seat is derived from the glyph's ink, which sits at button-local top+10 because the 14x14 SVG carries about 5 px of glyph-free padding above and below the dots, so wave-7's editor_panel top 10 px seated the ink at surface-y 20, three px BELOW the 35 px strip's tab-label line at 17; superseded to editor_panel top 6 px (ink 16) and dashboard top 2 px / right 13 px (ink 12, three above the 31 px header's title line at 15), with right 13 px and the 34 px dashboard-actions margin unchanged and the grip hit-triangle concession confined to glyph-free padding (about 50 px2 editor, about 4 px2 dashboard) so the dot column stays clickable on both kinds. (2) Floating chat regains a Dock back row, reversing wave 7's retirement of that row while leaving wave 7's single-menu exception intact: the T20 kebab stays skipped and removed for chat and the row is injected into the BASE .pm6-chat-more-menu as one button.pm6-chat-more-item carrying data-pm-home-chat-row=redock with an inline currentColor SVG and no emoji, inserted before .closeChatBtn, shown only while surface.host === floating with the base .popOutBtn hidden for the duration; wireActions' capture listener handles [data-pm-home-chat-row] before [data-pm-home-action], calls moveSurface(chat, last_docked_host || home_main) and deliberately does not preventDefault or stopImmediatePropagation so the base delegated handler still closes the menu with its portal animation. No new command id is introduced - moveSurface off a floating host emits the existing cmd.panel.redock. (3) Snap-while-dragging EDSHAPE contract, amending wave 7's drag-cover fix as correct but incomplete: the plate was already opaque in all eight themes, and the residue was the grab-spring, since grabbing a non-active tab flips the strip's active key, so sync() set animate=true and sprang the plate across roughly 12 frames while the carried tab paints nothing, and sub-0.5 px pointermoves parked in the spring-preservation early return and held the hole open indefinitely on slow drags - a live violation of the 1:1-no-independent-easing canon F3-505 already owned. sync() now forces animate=false whenever the strip contains .tab.dragging and the preservation guard is qualified by that flag, so the snap branch runs in the activating frame; a glass drag-scoped plate frost at opacity .92 satisfies the user's like-a-blur request without any backdrop-filter, and the T16 count pin stays 134. (4) Home scroll kill with a corrected mechanism: wave 7's overflow-x clip claim is false because clip beside overflow-y auto computes to hidden per CSS Overflow 3 s3.1, so the hosts remained scroll containers whose scrollLeft still moved 12 px and Safari 15 and earlier drop the declaration entirely; the overflow is removed at its three measured 1920x1080 sources instead (empty-dock padding 0, 8 px; a zero-extent PM_EDGE frost-band guard, 22 px; home_main's pairless last divider, 12 px), belted by overflow clip on both axes for #pm-home-workspace, .pm-home-host-grid and #panel-dashboard.pm-home-owned, with wave 7's scrollbar-color declaration replaced by ID-anchored zero-width host scrollbars and a documented sub-1320 px overflow-x auto reachability exception.
